comparatorSelection.invalid: any invalid/incomplete development attempt makes its stratum inconclusive; null T cannot win
comparatorSelection.means: arithmetic, one observation per replicate; exact rationals

declaration.developmentAdvance: primary32 bracketed, thresholds 1 and 2 pass, no no-more-expensive baseline dominates M and T; otherwise stop before holdout
declaration.dominanceUncertainty: mean-only dominance with replicate order changes is inconclusive, not equivalence
declaration.missingBracket: stratum inconclusive; missing controls prevent a positive whole-study conclusion
declaration.retention: every declared attempt including failures, exact inputs, diagnostics and host costs; serial pack and restoration before deleting raw work copies
declaration.retries: none; infrastructure recovery requires a separate retained identity

thresholds.allStrataExclusions: no additional running-target exclusions when L records zero
thresholds.primaryPercentileCI: 0.975 two-sided; gains versus L exclude zero; upper CIs candidate-H M,T,F,U <=0
thresholds.regressionPercentileCI: 0.95 paired descriptive; uncertainty crossing guardrail makes positive claim inconclusive
thresholds.upperComparator: candidate M,T,F,U <= H; recheck L/candidate/H bracket on holdout
